text: LangChain document loaders convert information from files and websites into Document objects.
Text splitting divides large documents into smaller pieces so retrieval systems can return focused context.
Chunk overlap keeps some text from one chunk in the next chunk and helps preserve context across boundaries.
TextLoader loads plain text into Document objects.
CSVLoader converts CSV rows into documents.
PyPDFLoader loads PDF pages and page metadata.
RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter creates chunks using natural separators.
RAG retrieves relevant context before a language model generates an answer.
